battle.name: 納米比亞獨立戰爭
battle.brief: 納米比亞獨立戰爭始於1966年，西南非洲人民組織在奧萬博蘭地區以武裝鬥爭反抗南非殖民統治，行動其後擴及納米比亞全境，戰爭延續至1990年獨立。列舉的美軍加特林機槍（Gatling gun）於1860年已列裝，早於本戰爭開始，是美國陸軍武器體系中的旋轉式機槍。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 加特林機槍（Gatling gun）是美國陸軍早期採用的旋轉式機槍，可配置於固定陣位或車載武器位置，在陸軍火力體系中負責持續壓制與防衛。

countries: 這場戰爭在納米比亞史料中通常稱為納米比亞獨立戰爭，在南非檔案中則多稱為邊境戰爭；它不是1966年一次短暫交火，而是從北部起義延續到1990年建國的長期武裝衝突。開戰時，南非仍以國際聯盟委任統治的名義控制西南非亞，首要交戰方是南非國防軍與西南非亞人民組織SWAPO。1975年安哥拉獨立後，SWAPO武裝力量人民解放軍PLAN與安哥拉人民解放軍FAPLA、古巴部隊在同一戰區相互配合；南非則在安哥拉境內作戰，並支援安哥拉全國獨立聯盟UNITA。葡萄牙只在其殖民時期控制安哥拉，贊比亞與坦尚尼亞主要提供營地、訓練和轉運，不等同於前線交戰國。蘇聯、中國與美國主要提供武器、訓練、外交或情報支持，不能把支持國都列成直接作戰方。
countriesEn: This conflict is usually called the Namibian War of Independence in Namibian historiography, while South African records generally call it the Border War. It was not a single brief clash in 1966 but a long armed conflict extending from the northern uprising to independence in 1990. At the outset, South Africa still controlled South West Africa under the authority derived from the League of Nations mandate, and the principal opposing forces were the South African Defence Force and SWAPO. After Angola became independent in 1975, SWAPO's People's Liberation Army of Namibia, or PLAN, worked with the Angolan forces known as FAPLA and Cuban troops in the same theatre. South Africa fought inside Angola and supported the National Union for the Total Independence of Angola, or UNITA. Portugal controlled Angola only during its colonial rule, while Zambia and Tanzania mainly supplied camps, training, and transit and were therefore not front-line belligerents. The Soviet Union, China, and the United States mainly provided weapons, training, diplomatic assistance, or intelligence, and should not all be classified as direct combatants.
people: 西南非亞人民組織一方的核心人物包括Hosea Kutako、Andimba Toivo ya Toivo、Sam Nujoma與Hage Geingob。Kutako是第一任主席，並協助籌措早期武器；Toivo ya Toivo兼任組織的武裝領導人，1960年代中後期在贊比亞盧薩卡建立境外總部，協調訓練、武器和外交；Nujoma負責海外聯絡與支持網，1990年成為總統；Geingob自1970年擔任流亡政府主席，1989年回國就任總理。南非方面，陸軍參謀長Johannes D. Becker主持最初的軍事應戰，Constand Viljoen則先在西南非亞指揮師級與旅級部隊，後任陸軍參謀長，延續跨境打擊與前線部署。安哥拉總統Agostinho Neto、古巴領導人Fidel Castro與古巴在安哥拉部隊指揮官Arnaldo Ochoa都直接影響戰區局勢；聯合國秘書長Kurt Waldheim則參與結束戰爭的外交安排。
peopleEn: The central SWAPO figures included Hosea Kutako, Andimba Toivo ya Toivo, Sam Nujoma, and Hage Geingob. Kutako was its first president and helped acquire the early weapons. Toivo ya Toivo also served as an armed leadership figure and established an external headquarters in Lusaka, Zambia, during the middle and late 1960s, where he coordinated training, weapons, and diplomacy. Nujoma organized overseas contacts and support networks and became president in 1990. Geingob headed the government in exile from 1970 and returned as prime minister in 1989. On the South African side, Chief of the Army Johannes D. Becker directed the initial military response. Constand Viljoen first commanded brigade-level and division-level formations in South West Africa and later became Chief of the Army, continuing the policy of cross-border strikes and forward deployment. Angolan President Agostinho Neto, Cuban leader Fidel Castro, and Arnaldo Ochoa, commander of the Cuban forces in Angola, directly influenced the theatre. United Nations Secretary-General Kurt Waldheim also participated in the diplomacy that ended the war.
kits: 以下型號在1966年以前或最遲於1966年已經列裝。SWAPO早期武器庫與外部接應中可辨認M1941 Johnson步槍、7.7公厘口徑的Bren L2A1機槍、9公厘Sten Mk II衝鋒槍，以及英國Lee-Enfield No.4步槍；後期PLAN則使用蘇聯AK-47及中國Type 56、捷克制式vz.52步槍、Mosin M91/30步槍和從安哥拉軍庫繳獲的FN FAL。RPG-2與1961年開始列裝的RPG-7用於反裝甲，BM-37 82公厘迫擊炮、DShK 12.7公厘重機槍及ZPU-1 14.5公厘高射機槍構成PLAN的火力支點，GAZ-69與ZIL-157卡車則負責邊境運輸。南非陸軍配備FN FAL R1、FN MAG 7.62公厘機槍、Sterling衝鋒槍、105公厘L5／M2A1系列火炮及155公厘M114榴彈炮，Centurion Mk 3坦克可執行師級防禦；Land Rover Series II 109吋與Bedford RL卡車承擔道路巡邏和補給。空運與支援由Fokker C-1、DHC-4 Caribou、C-130A、Alouette III及Mirage III擔任。不同口徑的7.7公厘、7.62×39、7.62×51及9公厘彈藥並存，使零件、彈帶與維修工具的供應格外複雜。
kitsEn: Every weapon and vehicle named here had entered service before 1966 or by 1966 itself. Identifiable weapons in SWAPO's early caches and external channels included the M1941 Johnson rifle, the 7.7 mm Bren L2A1, the 9 mm Sten Mk II, and the British Lee-Enfield No. 4. PLAN later used Soviet AK-47 rifles and Chinese Type 56 copies, Czech vz. 52 rifles, Mosin M91/30 rifles, and FN FALs recovered from Angolan stores. RPG-2 and the RPG-7, which entered Soviet service in 1961, served against armour, while BM-37 82 mm mortars, DShK 12.7 mm heavy machine guns, and ZPU-1 14.5 mm anti-aircraft guns formed the core of PLAN's fire support. GAZ-69 and ZIL-157 trucks carried supplies across the border. The South African Army fielded the FN FAL R1, FN MAG 7.62 mm machine gun, Sterling submachine gun, 105 mm L5/M2A1 family howitzers, and 155 mm M114 howitzers. Centurion Mk 3 tanks could perform divisional defence, while Land Rover Series II 109-inch vehicles and Bedford RL trucks handled road patrols and logistics. Fokker C-1, DHC-4 Caribou, and C-130A aircraft, Alouette III helicopters, and Mirage III fighters provided transport, support, and strike missions. The coexistence of 7.7 mm, 7.62×39, 7.62×51, and 9 mm ammunition complicated the supply of ammunition, belts, and maintenance tools.
tactics: 1966年起步時，SWAPO以分散小隊保存武器和成員，先襲擊警察哨所、軍事據點及補給車隊，破壞通訊，再迅速轉移，使南非無法集中兵力逐個清除。Operation Windhoek期間，南非投入步兵營、裝甲車、火炮、軍用直升機與固定路障，以主要公路為搜索軸線，配合空中觀察和情報網逐區清剿；它找到大批武器庫並迫使部分戰鬥人員投降或越境，卻未能摧毀整個組織。1966年後，PLAN把訓練與補給中心移至贊比亞、坦尚尼亞及安哥拉境內，再以小組徒步滲透或卡車縱隊進入西南非亞。1970年代起，PLAN逐步建立包含步兵、迫擊炮、反裝甲小組及後勤單位的旅級部隊，偏好攻擊據點、伏擊運輸線和破壞道路後迅速撤離。南非則採取前線區戰略，在安哥拉部署部隊，以突擊隊深入打擊營區、 artillery空襲和炮火封鎖跨境運輸，同時與UNITA協同作戰但維持各自指揮。1987至1988年的庫伊托・夸納瓦萊戰役中，SWAPO、FAPLA與古巴部隊挖掘野戰工事並圍困南非據點，南非以空軍、火炮和地面部隊解圍。到1988年，雙方都無法單靠戰場手段改變政治目標，長期戰爭遂轉向外交談判。
tacticsEn: At the beginning of 1966, SWAPO used dispersed teams to preserve weapons and personnel, strike police posts, military positions, and supply convoys, disrupt communications, and move away before a sweep could close around them. During Operation Windhoek, South Africa committed infantry battalions, armoured vehicles, artillery, military helicopters, and roadblocks, searched along the main roads, and combined aerial observation with an intelligence network. The operation recovered large caches and forced some fighters to surrender or cross the border, but it did not destroy the organisation. After 1966, PLAN moved its training and supply centres into Zambia, Tanzania, and Angola, then sent small teams on foot or in truck columns into South West Africa. From the 1970s, PLAN gradually built brigade-sized formations containing infantry, mortars, anti-tank teams, and logistics units. Its preferred methods were to attack installations, ambush transport routes, damage roads, and withdraw before a counterattack could develop. South Africa adopted a forward-area strategy, deployed troops inside Angola, used commando teams to strike camps, relied on artillery and air attacks to seal cross-border routes, and cooperated with UNITA while retaining separate command arrangements. During the 1987–88 battle of Cuito Cuanavale, SWAPO, FAPLA, and Cuban troops constructed field fortifications and besieged South African positions, while South Africa relieved them with aircraft, artillery, and ground forces. By 1988 neither side could alter its political objectives through the battlefield alone, and the long war moved toward negotiation.
data: 1960年4月，SWAPO在溫得和克成立；1962至1964年間，組織把首批成批武器分散藏入西南非亞北部。1966年8月26日至9月6日，南非實施Operation Windhoek，取得大量武器庫，迫使武裝網絡轉入境外；同年，聯合國大會第2153號決議終止南非對西南非亞的委任統治權。1973年，SWAPO正式建立PLAN。1975年11月11日安哥拉獨立，當月下旬古巴部隊抵達安哥拉，非洲大陸的戰爭與西南非亞戰線因而直接相連；1976年後，PLAN由零散游擊轉向以安哥拉營區為後方的跨境行動。1987至1988年的庫伊托・夸納瓦萊戰役成為最大規模的地面對抗，1988年12月22日安哥拉、古巴與南非簽署三方協議。1989年11月27日舉行選舉，12月8日停火，1990年3月21日納米比亞宣布獨立。南非的後勤主軸是海運至沃爾菲斯灣，再經鐵路到溫得和克並向北部延伸，公路與航空線連接前進據點；PLAN的補給則由贊比亞和坦尚尼亞進入安哥拉，再以卡車和徒步小組送往邊境。到1980年代，兩邊都能建立縱深供應與定期車隊，但Walvis Bay港及鐵路仍對南非維持控制至1994年3月1日。
dataEn: SWAPO was founded in Windhoek in April 1960, and between 1962 and 1964 it dispersed its first large shipment of weapons across northern South West Africa. South Africa conducted Operation Windhoek from 26 August to 6 September 1966, recovered large caches, and forced the armed network into exile. That year, United Nations General Assembly Resolution 2153 terminated South Africa's authority over South West Africa under the former mandate. SWAPO formally established PLAN in 1973. Angola became independent on 11 November 1975, and Cuban troops arrived later that month, directly joining the African conflict to the South West African front. From 1976, PLAN moved from scattered guerrilla actions toward cross-border operations supported by bases in Angola. The 1987–88 battle of Cuito Cuanavale became the largest conventional ground confrontation, and on 22 December 1988 Angola, Cuba, and South Africa signed the Tripartite Accord. Elections were held on 27 November 1989, a ceasefire followed on 8 December, and Namibia declared independence on 21 March 1990. South Africa's principal logistical axis ran from sea-borne supplies through Walvis Bay, by rail to Windhoek, and onward to the north, with roads and air routes reaching forward positions. PLAN's supplies entered Angola from Zambia and Tanzania and were then taken toward the border by truck and on foot by small teams. By the 1980s both sides could sustain depth and regular convoys, although the Walvis Bay port and railway remained under South African control until 1 March 1994.
cause: 戰爭的直接根源，是西南非亞地位與南非權力安排之間長期無法調和。國際聯盟在1920年把西南非亞交由南非管理，南非議會卻在1927年將其納入本土治理；國際法院1950年的諮詢意見及聯合國1966年的決議，均未承認南非可以自行終止委任義務。1948年後，南非把種族隔離制度逐步延伸至西南非亞，契約勞工、土地與資源管制及政治活動限制，使地方政治訴求難以在既有制度內實現。SWAPO在1960至1965年間曾以請願、聯合國交涉和公開組織作為主要方式，但領導人被拘押、禁令與鎮壓削弱合法活動，1966年的武裝起義及Operation Windhoek更使組織轉向地下鬥爭與境外領導。安哥拉反殖民戰爭提供跨境營地、武器來源和通往非洲其他地區的運輸節點，冷戰亦令蘇聯、中國、古巴與美國先後介入。南非把沃爾菲斯灣港口、安哥拉北部通道及邊境秩序視為戰略利益，SWAPO則以武裝鬥爭追求正式獨立，這些結構共同把1966年的衝突推成長期戰爭。
causeEn: The immediate roots of the war lay in the unresolved relationship between South West Africa's status and South African authority. The League of Nations assigned South West Africa to South Africa in 1920, but the South African Parliament incorporated it into domestic administration in 1927. Neither the International Court of Justice's 1950 advisory opinion nor the United Nations' 1966 resolution accepted South Africa's claim that it could terminate its mandate unilaterally. After 1948, South Africa progressively extended apartheid structures to South West Africa. Contract labour, land and resource controls, and restrictions on political activity made local demands difficult to pursue through existing institutions. From 1960 to 1965, SWAPO relied primarily on petitions, United Nations diplomacy, and open organisation. Arrests of leaders, bans, and repression weakened legal political activity, while the armed uprising of 1966 and Operation Windhoek pushed the organisation toward underground resistance and leadership from abroad. The Angolan anti-colonial war provided border camps, sources of weapons, and transport links to other parts of Africa, while the Cold War brought Soviet, Chinese, Cuban, and American involvement in stages. South Africa regarded Walvis Bay, the northern Angolan corridor, and border order as strategic interests, while SWAPO pursued formal independence through armed struggle. These structures together turned the conflict of 1966 into a prolonged war.
impact: 戰爭首先改變了雙方的軍事形態。PLAN由依靠少量武器的地下組織，發展成能以旅為單位實施步兵、迫擊炮、反裝甲和後勤協同的常規力量；南非國防軍則建立跨境打擊、前線區部署、專門偵察與情報支援體系，並提高空運、火炮及裝甲協同程度。安哥拉戰線把西南非亞戰爭與古巴革命軍、蘇聯武器體系、美國支持的UNITA及安哥拉各方力量連在一起，使原本邊境性的衝突成為冷戰在非洲的重要代理戰場。國際層面的壓力也迅速增加：聯合國安全理事會於1976年11月4日通過第418號決議，對南非實施強制武器禁運，聯合國大會同年承認SWAPO為納米比亞人民的代表。戰爭代價同樣巨大；由於作戰紀錄、失聯、疾病、處決及不同統計口徑互相交錯，總傷亡數字始終存在重大爭議，較可靠的說法是大量戰鬥人員死亡、受傷、被俘並留下長期身心傷殘，而不是提供一個看似精確的總數。軍事開支、輪替 stationed、邊境供應線與長期警戒亦加重南非及安哥拉體系的負擔，而戰爭經驗最終迫使南非放棄以持續軍事搜索取代政治協商的設想。
impactEn: The war first transformed both sides' military character. PLAN developed from an underground organisation with limited weapons into a conventional force capable of infantry, mortar, anti-tank, and logistics cooperation at brigade level. The South African Defence Force built a system of cross-border strikes, forward-area deployment, specialised reconnaissance, and intelligence support, while improving cooperation among airlift, artillery, armour, and infantry. The Angolan front connected the South West African war to the Cuban Revolutionary Armed Forces, the Soviet weapons system, US-backed UNITA, and the competing Angolan forces, turning a border conflict into an important proxy war of the Cold War in Africa. International pressure also rose quickly. On 4 November 1976, the United Nations Security Council adopted Resolution 418, imposing a mandatory arms embargo on South Africa, and the General Assembly recognised SWAPO as the representative of the Namibian people in the same year. The human cost was substantial. Because records of engagements, missing personnel, disease, executions, and different statistical definitions do not align, total casualty figures remain highly disputed. The safer conclusion is that large numbers of combatants were killed, wounded, or captured and endured lasting physical and psychological harm, rather than that a deceptively precise total can be given. The expense of the conflict, personnel rotations, border supply lines, and permanent vigilance burdened South African and Angolan systems. Military experience ultimately convinced South Africa that indefinite military searching could not replace a political settlement.
result: 戰爭最終不是一方在戰場上的全勝。南非仍控制西南非亞大部分地區，卻未能摧毀PLAN並迫使SWAPO接受有限自治；SWAPO同樣無法奪取溫得和克或迫使南非立即撤軍。1988年12月22日三方協議打開結束戰爭的道路，1989年聯合國過渡援助團督導選舉與停火，11月27日投票、12月8日停火之後，1990年3月21日Hage Geingob宣誓就任總理，Sam Nujoma就任總統，納米比亞正式獨立。SWAPO由武裝組織成為執政黨，PLAN與部分南非國防軍人員被整編為納米比亞國防軍；南非主力部隊隨即撤出大部分國土，僅繼續控制沃爾菲斯灣及沿海岸島嶼，直到1994年3月1日才將這些地區移交納米比亞。結果因此是一次經聯合國監督、由談判完成的權力轉移，而不是任何一方迫使對方全面投降；1966年北部爆發的衝突，也因此以1988年的停火協議、1989年的選舉和1990年的主權移交收束。
resultEn: The war ended without a complete battlefield victory for either side. South Africa retained control of most of South West Africa but failed to destroy PLAN or force SWAPO to accept limited autonomy. SWAPO likewise could not capture Windhoek or compel an immediate South African withdrawal. The Tripartite Accord of 22 December 1988 opened the way to ending the conflict. Under the supervision of the United Nations Transition Assistance Group, voting and the ceasefire followed in 1989, with the election on 27 November and the ceasefire on 8 December. On 21 March 1990, Hage Geingob was sworn in as prime minister, Sam Nujoma was sworn in as president, and Namibia formally became independent. SWAPO changed from an armed organisation into the governing party, while PLAN and personnel from the South African Defence Force were integrated into the Namibian Defence Force. Most South African troops then withdrew from the country, although South Africa retained Walvis Bay and the offshore islands until transferring them to Namibia on 1 March 1994. The result was therefore a UN-supervised transfer of authority through negotiation rather than the unconditional surrender of either side. The conflict that began in northern South West Africa in 1966 was consequently closed by the 1988 ceasefire agreement, the 1989 election, and the transfer of sovereignty in 1990.
